_comment: A planing hull's spray sheet: clumps of drops and torn filaments (textures/particles/spray_drops.png, a 4x4 atlas laid along the velocity). vfx/VesselSpray drives position, segment, direction, speeds and rate every frame, and the albedo (the colour keys' rgb) and forwardScatter from the ocean preset's spray knobs (OceanRenderConfig::sprayColor, sprayForwardScatter); these are the rest. Lit: the colour keys are an albedo under the sun and the air.
